scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, value proposition, and call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Open the MirDB landing page in a browser
steps.context: User discovers MirDB through search or referral

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains MirDB product name, tagline about persistent key-value store with memcached protocol, and value proposition
steps.context: REQ-1: Display hero section with MirDB product name, tagline, and primary value proposition

steps.description: Check that primary CTA 'Get Started' and secondary CTA 'View on GitHub' are present and clickable
steps.context: User should have clear paths to begin using MirDB

test_cases.input: Load landing page and inspect hero section DOM
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 with 'MirDB' product name
Tagline contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached Protocol' text
Primary CTA button with text 'Get Started' is visible and interactive
Secondary CTA link 'View on GitHub' is visible and links to GitHub repository

scenarios.name: Key Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify the features section highlights memcached compatibility, persistence, and LSM tree architecture

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate to the features section of the landing page
steps.context: REQ-2: Present key features section highlighting memcached compatibility, persistence, and LSM tree architecture

steps.description: Check that features are displayed in a three-column layout on desktop
steps.context: Interface requirement: Three-column layout for key differentiators

steps.description: Check that all three key differentiators are present with descriptions
steps.context: Memcached Compatible, Persistent Storage, High Performance

test_cases.expected: Features section contains three distinct feature cards/columns
Feature card with title containing 'Memcached' and description about existing clients/tooling compatibility
Feature card with title containing 'Persistent' and description about data surviving restarts via SSTable storage
Feature card with title containing 'Performance' and description about LSM tree architecture

scenarios.name: Quick Start Section
scenarios.description: Verify the quick-start section includes installation instructions and basic usage examples

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate to the quick-start section
steps.context: REQ-3: Include quick-start section with installation instructions and basic usage example

steps.description: Check that installation commands are displayed with proper code formatting
steps.context: Installation command (cargo/binary) should be clearly visible

steps.description: Check that basic configuration example is present
steps.context: Basic TOML configuration showing addr, work_dir, and other options

steps.description: Check that sample SET/GET commands are displayed
steps.context: REQ-9: Include code examples for common use cases

test_cases.input: Inspect quick-start section for installation commands
test_cases.expected: Code block containing cargo or binary installation instructions
Code block with TOML configuration showing addr = '0.0.0.0:12333' and work_dir
Code example showing 'set mykey 0 0 5' command with expected 'STORED' response
Code example showing 'get mykey' command with expected 'VALUE' response

scenarios.name: Supported Commands Section
scenarios.description: Verify the page displays supported memcached commands and protocol compatibility information

steps.description: Scroll to or navigate to the protocol compatibility section
steps.context: REQ-4: Display supported memcached commands and protocol compatibility information

steps.description: Check that standard memcached commands (SET, GET, DELETE, etc.) are listed
steps.context: Users with existing memcached integration need to verify compatibility

steps.description: Check that MirDB extensions (INFO, MAJOR_COMPACTION) are documented
steps.context: Users should understand MirDB-specific functionality

test_cases.expected: Commands section lists SET, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND
Commands section lists GET and GETS commands
Commands section lists DELETE command
Commands section lists INFO and MAJOR_COMPACTION as MirDB extensions

scenarios.name: Mobile Responsive Design

steps.context: NFR-2: Design must be responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

steps.context: Layout should adapt appropriately for tablet screens

steps.description: Ensure navigation and buttons are touch-friendly
steps.context: User Story 6: Navigation is touch-friendly

test_cases.expected: All content is visible without horizontal scrolling
Features stack vertically instead of three-column layout
Navigation is accessible (hamburger menu or collapsed nav)

scenarios.name: Page Performance
scenarios.description: Verify the landing page loads within acceptable performance thresholds

steps.description: Measure time from navigation start to DOM content loaded
steps.context: NFR-1: Page must load within 3 seconds on standard broadband connections

steps.description: Verify images and assets are optimized and appropriately sized
steps.context: Performance requirements: Static assets optimized and minified

steps.description: Execute Lighthouse performance audit and verify score
steps.context: Success Criteria: Page passes Lighthouse performance audit with score ≥ 80

test_cases.expected: Page loads completely within 3000ms
Critical CSS is inlined or loaded efficiently
Images are compressed and use appropriate formats (WebP, optimized PNG/JPG)
Lighthouse performance score is 80 or higher

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the landing page meets WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Navigate the entire page using only keyboard (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys)
steps.context: Accessibility Considerations: Keyboard navigation support

steps.description: Verify all text meets minimum contrast ratio requirements
steps.context: Accessibility Considerations: Sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)

steps.description: Verify proper heading hierarchy and ARIA labels
steps.context: Accessibility Considerations: Screen reader compatible markup

steps.description: Execute Lighthouse accessibility audit and verify score
steps.context: Success Criteria: Page passes Lighthouse accessibility audit with score ≥ 90

test_cases.input: Navigate page with Tab key only
test_cases.expected: All interactive elements are focusable and have visible focus indicators
Page has proper h1-h6 hierarchy without skipped levels
All images have descriptive alt attributes
All text meets WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
Lighthouse accessibility score is 90 or higher
